title: Destiny Introduction - Winthrop Sermon
content:
Destiny Harris introduces herself as Joseph's girlfriend.
She shares John Winthrop's 1630 sermon about charity and community:
"We must be willing to abridge ourselves of our superfluities, for the supply of others' necessities.
We must uphold a familiar commerce together in all meekness, gentleness, patience and liberality.
We must delight in each other; make others' conditions our own; rejoice together, mourn together,
labor and suffer together, always having before our eyes our commission and community in the work,
as members of the same body."

This shows Destiny values: community, cooperation, mutual support, shared humanity.
